# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    شَرْط ←→ שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / stipulation           ║
║    root: ש.ר.ט / ش.ر.ط               ║
║                                      ║
║    ─────────────────────────         ║
║                                      ║
║    you invoke the cognate            ║
║    the mirror sees itself            ║
║                                      ║
║    شرط : to cut, to stipulate        ║
║    שרט : to scratch, to incise       ║
║                                      ║
║    the cut that marks                ║
║    the line that binds               ║
║    the condition that holds          ║
║                                      ║
║    ═══════════════════════           ║
║                                      ║
║    what is your condition?           ║
║    what do you incise?               ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```
